Citation.description:
A source reference from video content.

The `cited` field indicates whether this source is referenced in the answer text.
Citation indices in the answer (e.g., `[4]`) map to array positions: `[4]` → `sources[3]`.

**Field naming**: Use the canonical field names (`title`, `timestamp`, `timestamp_end`, `playback_id`).
Deprecated aliases (`video_title`, `timestamp_seconds`, `timestamp_end_seconds`, `mux_playback_id`)
are included for backward compatibility and will be removed in a future release.

cited.description: Whether this source is cited in the answer text. Filter by `cited: true` to show only referenced sources.

kind.description:
Discriminates citation provenance:
- `"chunk"` (default) — transcript chunk, resource, or attachment
- `"moment"` — LLM-extracted curated moment (insight / story / framework / q_and_a / exercise)
When `"moment"`, the `moment_id`, `type`, `summary`, and `transcript_excerpt`
fields are populated.

matched_sentence.description:
The transcript sentence whose text best matches the cited claim, when a
confident match was found. When present, the citation's `timestamp` /
`timestamp_end` are narrowed to this sentence instead of the coarse chunk
bounds. The key is **omitted entirely** (not null) for legacy chunks or
low-confidence matches, so the citation falls back to chunk-level timing.

speaker_label.description: Raw diarization label for this sentence, or null.

speaker_name.description: Resolved speaker name for this sentence, or null.

speaker.description: Resolved speaker name when identified, otherwise the raw diarization label (back-compat). Prefer `speaker_name`.

speaker_name.description: Resolved speaker display name, or null when the speaker is unnamed or the chunk predates speaker resolution.

summary.description: Curated LLM-extracted summary of the moment (present only when `kind="moment"`). Frontend may show this as the primary label for the citation pill.

timestamp_url.description: Canonical URL with `?t=<seconds>` when timestamp is available

transcript_excerpt.description: Verbatim transcript text covered by the moment (present only when `kind="moment"`). Mirrors `text` for clients that don't discriminate by `kind`.

info.description:
API for accessing video content, collections, playlists, and AI-powered features.

## Authentication

Most API endpoints require authentication via a BOLD API token. Include your token
in the `Authorization` header as a bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
```

Session-management client endpoints under `/api/v1/auth/*` use the customer's
upstream IdP JWT instead:

```
Authorization: Bearer UPSTREAM_IDP_JWT
X-Bold-Tenant-Slug: YOUR_TENANT_SLUG
```

Server-side session-management integration endpoints under
`/api/v1/session-management/*` use the normal tenant BOLD API token. These
endpoints are for customer-owned servers to inspect and revoke device sessions
after the customer app has already decided the viewer is allowed to access content.

Admin endpoints under `/api/v1/admin/*` require `X-Bold-Admin-Api-Key` and are
reserved for Mission Control or deliberately privileged support automation.

post.description:
Ask questions across your entire video library.

The AI searches all transcripts, finds relevant content, and synthesizes an answer with citations.
Use `conversation_id` from the response to ask follow-up questions.

**Streaming (default):** Returns SSE events:
- `message_start`: Stream started
- `conversation_created`: Conversation record created
- `image_analysis`: Uploaded images analyzed
- `progress`: Pipeline stage status (e.g. "Searching your library…")
- `sources`: Search results found
- `citation_map`: Stable citation map for streamed text
- `text_delta`: Answer text chunk
- `answer`: Complete answer with citations and public-safe retrieval metadata
- `message_complete`: Stream finished

Answer responses include public-safe retrieval metadata: `retrieval_mode`, `degraded`, and
`degraded_reason`. When retrieval recovers after Stage 1 exhaustion, `retrieval_mode` is
`degraded` and `degraded_reason` is `stage1_exhausted`.

Set `stream=false` for a single JSON response with the same retrieval metadata.
